title: ftehe's Vanilla+
description: A collection of Mods and Resource Packs to make the game feel premium, without making it feel too heavily modded.
body:
![barblue](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81d6fc74fea3d44eb34a2b8ddd94dae89111ba92.png)

![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/20d977220bf2e8634b7783e8374320986e6e0211.png)

### An Immersive Vanilla+ Experience.

This modpack aims to deliver on that smooth and clean Minecraft feeling that you want and crave, with a perfect collection of mods and clean structure of resource packs.

I'll continue updating the modpack as the mods get updated, its either gonna be bi-weekly or monthly updates.

![bar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9b3edab4c46aeba256b31fae555952fd0c7a390.png)

![features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cff25db21644614cd3b5dc834f682c015cb75fc6.png)

  - 📍 **Host your World and Play with your Friends for FREE! Thanks to [Essential Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential).**
- 🌅 **Gorgeous Vanilla Atmosphere Thanks to [ATMOSPHERICS](https://modrinth.com/mod/atmospherics) and [Shine](https://modrinth.com/mod/shine) Combined!**
- ⚡ **High FPS and Reduced RAM Usage thanks to [Noisium](https://modrinth.com/mod/noisiumforked), [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling), [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core), [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast).**
- 🧱 **New Structures from [Dungeons and Taverns](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons-and-taverns) and its many overhauls!**
- 🍎 **New Food to be gathered and made thanks to [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) and its Addons.**
- 🐟 **New Fish and Crates to be caught thanks to [Gone Fishing](https://modrinth.com/mod/gone-fishing).**
- ✨ **Refreshed and Animated UI thanks to [Blur+](https://modrinth.com/mod/blur-plus), [Chat Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/chatanimation), [SmoothHud](https://modrinth.com/mod/smooth-hud), [Inventory Particles](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-particles).**
- 🏃 **Fresh Animations and Revamped Mobs thanks to [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations) and [ALtheGatorMC's Resource Packs](https://modrinth.com/user/ALtheGatorMC).**
